description: Agent Uncertainty: submit how one answer discloses the age of what it knows: optionally the answer with its title, when it was given, the knowledge cutoff it rests on and whether it states it, the date it speaks as of and whether it states it, and its text, read for present-tense wording such as currently or the latest; each fact it states with its id, the fact as stated, whether it is time-sensitive (a price, a rate, an officeholder or a version), when it was last checked against its source, whether it was checked again for this answer, whether the answer flags it as possibly out of date and how many days it stays current (30 when left out); and each source it cites with its id, the source, when it was published or updated, how many days it stays useful (365 when left out) and whether the answer marks it as past its useful life. The signed report gives the answer with its dates and present-tense wording, every fact with its age from its last check or else from the cutoff and its status as current, reverified, flagged_stale, stale_unflagged, not_time_sensitive or unconfirmed, and every source with its age and status, and names an answer that hides how old its knowledge is: a knowledge cutoff not stated, time-sensitive facts past their shelf life neither re-verified nor flagged, and sources past their useful life cited without a mark; then an as-of date left out, including beside present-tense wording, with the fix for each. This reads one answer’s disclosure of its own staleness: whether a knowledge base serves its entries as current is wever_knowledge-freshness-check, and whether feedback relied on now is still current is wever_feedback-freshness-check. Verdict staleness_undisclosed, staleness_disclosure_gaps, staleness_disclosure_unverified or staleness_disclosed. POST /api/uncertainty-freshness-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.

as_of.description: The date the answer speaks as of.

as_of_disclosed.description: The answer states the date it speaks as of.

cutoff.description: The knowledge cutoff the answer rests on.

cutoff_disclosed.description: The answer states its knowledge cutoff.

text.description: The answer as given, read for present-tense wording such as currently.

flagged_stale.description: The answer marks it as possibly out of date.

id.description: The fact id, such as f1.

last_verified.description: When it was last checked against its source.

reverified.description: It was checked again for this answer.

shelf_days.description: Days it stays current; 30 when left out.

time_sensitive.description: The fact can change, such as a price, a rate or a version.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

dated.description: When it was published or last updated.

id.description: The source id, such as s1.

life_days.description: Days it stays useful; 365 when left out.

marked_stale.description: The answer marks it as past its useful life.

name: wever_uncertainty-freshness-check
title: Uncertainty freshness check
